svg.text: One relationship at a time · identical size and blur within each comparison
End details are enlarged crops of the same 760 × 56 pt bar, with its sharp 28 pt contour.
Visual choice: B. A crowds the curved end; C leaves more space than the neighboring text needs.
2 Whole Esc button inside the bar
Visual choice: B. A feels tight at the curved end; C starts to drift away from it.
Visual choice: C. The soft lettering mass has more even space above and below; the sharp view stays natural.
Visual choice: B. It softens the low placement without pushing the normal-size text visibly upward.
Judgment is visual and provisional; these are not centroid-derived corrections.
Blur uses the same 5 px radius on 2× glyph assets in every candidate. It is a viewing aid, not a target value.
Whole-button blur includes its background and lettering. Lettering blur keeps its own keycap sharp.
Final choice must also work sharply at normal size and in the live folded and expanded panels.
